question: On boards with length targets (class minimum lengths or matched groups decided from the net names), does the krt-meander stage (run last, after the optimizer) bring every targeted net into its window, or report each net's shortfall, without a new clearance violation, a via in a pad, a new unrouted connection or a new Java length violation? The stage stays a selectable stage if that holds; it is off by default either way.

off.engine: freerouting-rs at the commit that lands X07, freerouting-krt's in-process harness (the CLI does not call freerouting_krt::register yet, C07)
off.command: X07_SET=tools/bench/sets/x07-length.txt X07_RECORDS=<out>/records.json cargo test --release -p freerouting-krt --test length measurement_records_on_a_set -- --ignored --exact --nocapture

settings.all other settings: the defaults (optimizer on, as the CLI)

on.engine: the same commit and harness; the stage runs on the off arm's final board, which is what selecting it does (it is the last stage)
on.command: the same run; one records file holds both arms

settings.length_matching.groups: the row's groups= list in tools/bench/sets/x07-length.txt

boards.dsn: the three synthetic boards in crates/freerouting-krt/tests/data and three boards of F03.3's out-of-repo corpus (target/corpus/prepped, tools/corpus/prep.sh)

eligibility: decided from the inputs: a committed synthetic board with a class minimum or a group, or a corpus board with at least two nets matched by a group glob written from its net names before any run (DVI and USB pairs on picodvi, PCIe RX and TX lanes on pcie-active-backplane, the USB pair on mydevboard-rp2040dev). A row whose groups resolve to no net, or whose off arm leaves every net in tolerance, is neutral and printed.
grading: Rust's DRC (DesignRulesChecker: clearance violations, incompletes, Java's length-violation count) and the via-in-pad test of crates/freerouting-krt/tests/length.rs, on both arms; KiCad grading (F02.6) of the corpus rows' sessions is a second step once the harness writes their SES (not graded is never a pass)

metric_definitions.via_in_pad: vias whose centre lies in a pin's pad on a shared layer
metric_definitions.nets_out_of_tolerance: off: the nets the stage would give a target (a group member below longest - tolerance, or a net below its class minimum); on: the nets the stage reports as not met (shortfall, conflict or stopped)

decision_table.pass: keep krt-meander as a selectable stage (off by default); X07.6 ticks and DIVERGENCES.md gets no line (no default changes)
decision_table.fail: a guard regression is a bug to fix before the stage is kept; a board where nets stay out of tolerance with their shortfall reported is not a failure (the Accept clause allows it)

timing: the registered run waits for P04's default-tree decision (P00 README 'Order', Q00 README 'Order and critical path'): the off arm routes, so its numbers depend on the tree
